metric: Maximum sustained aggregate RBD read-throughput decrease during confirmed OSD down to repair complete
progress_matching: Per-client cumulative RBD read bytes normalized within pass; midpoint of window read-progress endpoints. Application CSV validates 3600 steps / 900 GiB per pass; exact per-step wall-clock progress unavailable.
reference: For each of 3 no-fault trials and each client: median of eligible same-duration same-pass windows within progress tolerance; sum client medians, then mean across the 3 trial estimates. Synthetic progress-conditioned aggregate, not a contemporaneous no-fault window.
progress_proxy_requirements: Pass counter coverage >=99%; RBD/logical read ratio between 0.9 and 1.1. Audit recorded, not assumed.
selection: Original primary-only replication; OptLRC faults 01/03/04; all other selected faults 01/02/03.
phase_boundary_policy: Recovery-phase-crossing windows retained and labeled; pass-crossing windows excluded.
post_repair_scope: Repair complete through earlier client analysis end; target OSD remains down until after both jobs finish.
interpretation: Observed decrease relative to estimated matched reference, not a causal estimate; rolling-window overlap and search over many windows increase extreme-value sensitivity. No pointwise significance claim.
